items.title: The Dating App Tapping A24 to Keep Users Coming Back for More
items.why: Culture-brand tie-ins like this show how consumer apps borrow entertainment partners, a model for loyalty marketing.
items.summary_ai: A dating app is partnering with film studio A24 to drive repeat engagement among its users.
items.take: Culture-brand tie-ins like this show how consumer apps borrow entertainment partners, a model for loyalty marketing.
